title: HKO ARWF Exact-Vintage Prospective Collector
mission: Implement prospective collection of every ARWF station forecast issue, raw payload and hourly station trajectory with exact first-seen time.
steps: Discover and document the actual machine-readable source used by current code.
Poll frequently enough to detect issues without assuming a fixed 0400/1600 or noon/midnight schedule; store observed issue/first-seen times.
Preserve raw payload and response headers.
Normalize station, issue, valid time, lead, temperature, RH, wind and precipitation/weather fields.
Map every station to the registry.
Store all issues, not just latest.
Alert on parser/schema changes and missing station/lead cells.
acceptance: Every future issue archived with raw lineage
ARWF remains challenger until evidence threshold
failure: No machine-readable historical archive: document; do not invent past issues
